frequency_question: What proportion of major central government industrial/financial schemes are fully gazetted within 350 days of initial policy conceptualization?
membership_rule: Includes all centrally sponsored financial incentive, credit guarantee, or subsidy schemes for heavy transport, manufacturing, or infrastructure sectors. Excludes minor scheme amendments and purely administrative circulars.
